name: techdella/video
title: Video (self-hosted)
description: Self-hosted video from Uploads (§6.3): WebM + MP4 sources, poster, captions. Loop mode plays muted only near the viewport, has a pause button, and shows the poster only for visitors who prefer reduced motion. Player mode shows controls and never autoplays.

attributes.title: How a new lead is handled
attributes.label: Example

techdella.help: scene: a motion sample slug (e.g. mo-03-ai-answer-cited) imported with `wp td media:videos`; it fills mp4/webm/poster/captions in the format that matches ratio (16:9 wide, 1:1 square, 9:16 tall), and any file set here overrides it. mp4/webm/poster/captions: a Media Library ID or a URL in Uploads (render with `npm run motion:render`, then upload assets/video/<id>-<format>.*). title names the video for screen readers and VideoObject schema; description and duration (seconds) complete the schema. label: e.g. Example or Concept. Never autoplays with sound; no YouTube embeds above the fold (§6.3). items: several clips in a row, each {scene, title, description, duration, label, caption}; the other settings are shared. heading (one *accent* word), intro, chip and surface (canvas|sand|dark) wrap the video(s) in a section with a heading.
